description:
Local-first AI token usage & cost tracker for 29 AI coding tools — with native apps. Never reads prompts.

TokenTracker is an accurate, local-first token usage and cost dashboard for 29 AI coding tools including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, and Qoder. It automatically collects token usage and aggregates everything locally, with a desktop pet, 4 native widgets, and 15 achievement tracks. No cloud account, no API keys, no setup. The Windows app runs as a system-tray companion that never reads your prompts.
Preserve historical Codex counts on upgrade, include pending usage in account totals, fix Antigravity quota ordering and premature reset alerts, and keep maximized Windows dashboards above the taskbar.
What's Changed
- fix(windows): keep maximized dashboard inside the monitor work area (#1152) by @xiufengsun in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/1153
- fix(antigravity): list 5h above 7d in the limits panel by @MilesYP in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/1162
- fix(local-api): fold not-yet-uploaded usage into the account view by @dominikzabcik in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/1164
New Contributors
- @MilesYP made their first contribution in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/1162
Full Changelog: https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/compare/v1.5.32...v1.5.33
